name: Whisper large-v2
notes: ENCODER-DECODER. Same architecture as large-v3 except num_mel_bins 80 (vs 128 in large-v3). ENCODER: 32 layers, d_model 1280, 20 heads, encoder_ffn_dim 5120, gelu, num_mel_bins 80, max_source_positions 1500. DECODER: 32 layers, 20 heads, decoder_ffn_dim 5120, max_target_positions 448. KV CACHE: decoder self-attention 32 * 20 * 64 * 2 * 2 = 163,840 B/token = 160 KiB/token. Cross-attention over 1500 encoder frames: 32 * 20 * 64 * 1500 * 2 * 2 = 245,760,000 B = 234 MiB per in-flight request. STREAMING: not natively supported (offline/batch model).
